description: Observes public content without modifying its source. Adds a Fresh402 baseline and uses free registration capacity for new watches; never charges USDC or credits. Use free ($0) Register to save a public HTTPS baseline; no trial key, wallet or payment. Required url plus optional content/attribute rules identifies the watch. Save returned watch_id/hash for Check, Smart Diff or OpenAPI Contract Diff. When flagship workflows are advertised, compatible Website/API workflows accept source_watch_id to adopt this public baseline with its exact rules/time for one separately authorized comparison; it grants no private ownership and performs no extra baseline fetch. Same URL/rules returns existing state without fetching or refreshing; different rules identify another watch. It is not continuous monitoring. HTML/JSON/text only; no JavaScript, private or authenticated targets. DNS/fetch/quota limits apply, including on repeat calls. For walletless first Check inspect root instant_evaluation.enabled and set evaluation:true; separate /v3/agent-trial requires ownership signing. Connection grants no signing or payment authority.

inputSchema.description: Register a free baseline using a required URL and optional content rules. The canonical URL plus rules identify the watch; changing rules creates a different watch. Repeating the same registration returns its existing watch_id/hash without fetching or refreshing it. Quotas apply. Reuse the returned watch_id in Check, Smart Diff or OpenAPI Contract Diff.

html_attributes.description: Optional HTML-only watch rule: up to4 of href,title,alt,aria-label; default[] retains existing text-only normalization. Distinct names are sorted; nonempty rules create a separate version1 watch/baseline. Records bounded meaningful attributes within the saved selector or filtered page, including same-text link destination changes. Cannot be supplied with watch_id, even[]. Unsafe hrefs are hashed, never fetched. Limits:200 elements,2048 characters/value,32768 evidence bytes; excess fails, never clips silently.

items.description: One explicitly observed HTML attribute: href (a/area only),title,alt or aria-label. No class/style/event attributes; links are inert evidence and never fetched.

ignore_json_paths.description: Optional array of up to 20 JSON Pointer-style paths to remove before JSON normalization and hashing. Each must start with '/' and be 1-256 characters; supports '*' segments. Default: [] (no exclusions). JSON only. Example: ['/updated_at', '/items/*/request_id'].

items.description: JSON Pointer-style path, 1-256 characters, starting with '/'. Decode '~0' as '~' and '~1' as '/'; '*' matches all object keys or array elements. Example: '/items/*/updated_at'.

ignore_selectors.description: Optional array of up to 20 CSS selectors (each 1-256 characters) to remove from HTML in addition to built-in noise filtering. Default: no extra exclusions ([]). HTML only; use ignore_json_paths for JSON. Example: ['.timestamp', '.ad'].

items.description: HTML element(s) to remove before normalization: a supported CSS selector, 1-256 characters, e.g. '.timestamp' or 'nav'.

selector.description: Optional HTML scope: a supported CSS selector, 1-256 characters, e.g. 'main' or 'article .content'. Only matching text is normalized; no match returns 422. Omit to normalize the page after built-in noise removal. Not supported for JSON or plain text.

url.description: Required absolute public HTTPS document URL, at most 4096 characters, e.g. 'https://example.com/docs'. Only port 443; no embedded credentials, private/local targets or authenticated pages. Fresh402's own service URLs, including its discovery /openapi.json, cannot be targets; choose an external public document. HTML, JSON and plain text are supported; JavaScript is not executed. DNS, redirect and size limits also apply.

anyOf.description: Tool error only; accompanied by isError=true.
Unpaid x402 v2 quote only; accompanied by isError=true. No product execution or financial authorization.

outputSchema.description: A successful tool execution follows the canonical result branch. isError=true denotes an error or unpaid payment challenge, never successful execution or payment. Inspect isError before interpreting structuredContent.
